name: ek9716
title: EK9716

facts.source: the datasheet of the EK9716 (Preliminary): a source driver with a timing controller for 24-bit parallel RGB, set by its pins MODE, DITHB, SHLR and UPDN; ESP32-8048S070 Specifications-EN.pdf names it the driver chip of that board

notes: A glass on the EK9716 takes no commands: its pins on the glass choose DE or sync mode, dithering and the directions of the scan. A program sees only the size and the timing of the glass.
